title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix $X$ includes all the features used in the model, plus an additional column for the intercept. How does this affect the number of features?

title: Counting the Features
text: If the design matrix $X$ has $n$ columns, and one of these columns is for the intercept, how many columns represent the actual features?

title: Calculating the Number of Features
text: Given that the design matrix $X$ has $n$ columns, and one column is for the intercept, calculate the number of features in the original data set.
